# AGENT-OVERHAUL closure audit — 2026-10-01

Audit snapshot: `5de382acfc779c019f558bd30f924373d2a1b38c` with a dirty shared worktree. This report changes no production file or roadmap state and runs no app, build or model. The full closure request includes phases 0–6, product-promise exits X01–X11 and action-validity tasks CU-01–CU-05. No task or gate is removed to make closure easier.

Canonical STATUS ledger: **145 entries** =129 P tasks/subtasks  + 11 X exits  + 5 CU tasks. Recorded states: {'todo': 69, 'done': 71, 'blocked': 1, 'in progress; no promotion': 1, 'in progress': 3}. These are record counts, **not verified completion counts**. A historical `done` row means the earlier bounded work was committed, not that all original steps, runtime environments, parent gates or present worktree behavior are proved.

## Closure verdict

**Not achieved.** Sixty-nine rows are explicitly todo, four parents/foundations are in progress, one is blocked. Current retained CORE is 15/18 (dictation, wake accuracy, computer inspect fail), the model quick/full/owner promotion bars are unmet, live latency/full-duplex ownership contracts are absent, and product promise/channel/live user exits are unproved. Parallel agents can advance disjoint dependency fronts; they cannot make an unavailable grant/model/account, seven-day trial or external-user evidence true by adding a test helper.

Classification used below: **BOUNDED EVIDENCE** = relevant actual production-path evidence inspected for the stated child only; **HISTORICAL/UNVERIFIED** = prior row/evidence exists but full current contract is not re-proved; **INCOMPLETE** = task/required deliverable absent or todo; **CONTRADICTED** = retained measurement violates its bar; **PARTIAL** = some producer exists but the full behavior has not been shown. All unevaluated individual requirements inherit UNVERIFIED/INCOMPLETE, never PASS.

- **Target behaviour / line812:** 2. It decides **when** a turn ends, never **whether** the app hears it: it can only shorten or lengthen the wait within fixed bounds; every held turn commits at a ceiling; no text is dropped or classified by it.

- **contract / line953:** - `public init(config: VadConfig = .default, progressHandler: ProgressHandler? = nil) async throws` — loads `silero-vad-unified-256ms-v6.2.1.mlmodelc` through `ModelHub` from `FluidInference/silero-vad-coreml` (MIT) into `~/Library/Application Support/FluidAudio/Models/`, **downloading it if missing** (~1 MB; this Mac has only v6.0.0). - **contract / line954:** - `public struct VadConfig { defaultThreshold: Float = 0.85; debugMode = false; computeUnits: MLComputeUnits = .cpuAndNeuralEngine }`.
- **contract / line955:** - `public func process(_ samples: [Float]) async throws -> [VadResult]` — splits into 4096-sample chunks and runs them **from a fresh LSTM state** each call; one 4096-sample window → exactly one `VadResult { probability: Float; isVoiceActive: Bool; processingTime: TimeInterval; outputState: VadState }`.

## File ownership collisions and validation discipline

- Foreign modified files include AGENTS.md, README.md, Scripts/acceptance.sh, NextNotesApp.swift, ActionRuntime/ACP computer integration, iMessage, app UI and site/docs. This audit changed only itself. Root must stage only scoped owned hunks; roadmap files are ignored and should not be force-added.
- P6-04a/TaskBridge share AgentTaskManager and AgentTask types; serial ownership only. ToolStepRunner belongs to the same final approval/validity boundary, not a place for a duplicate approval gate.
- P2 work and P3 work share AgentCaptureController, VoiceConversationCoordinator, LocalVoiceFrontend, speech/RealtimeAudioSession; split audits/helpers first and freeze producers during serial root integration.
- P4 memory tasks touch NextMemory/MemoryTools/MemoryReviewer and other memory-lifecycle work. P4 prompt/routine files may share AgentPromptAssembler/Persona and SourceConsent. Coordinate producer ownership before edits.
- P6-07 UsageRecord/UsageLogSelfTest shares active iMessage and dictation provenance owners; do not simultaneously overwrite optional fields or create a task metrics store.
- No build/app launch/model run was performed in this audit. Parent owns full serial builds, make install OPEN=0, foreground installed run-selftest wrapper, launch isolation and source-hash freeze. Isolated fixtures never seed owner stores. No real SaaS message/action is authorized by this audit.
